sections.heading: Cheating During Testing Roblox Guide
sections.intro: Your goal is to complete the test before time runs out, improve the grade and keep every risky action outside the teacher's attention.
paragraphs: A round combines the answer sheet, the timer, teacher movement and your current loadout. Completing a test awards Credits, and higher grades give larger rewards. Those Credits buy gadgets and equipment that can make later runs faster or easier to manage.

New players should learn one clean loop first: open the current sheet, check the version, prepare the answers, watch the teacher, use the Phone only during a short opening, apply the returned corrections and leave enough time to review and submit. Anxiety and Snitches add pressure, so a greedy final scan can be worse than safely finishing the paper.

subsections.heading: The exam loop
paragraphs: Open the answer sheet, work through the paper, use gadgets in short windows and complete the test before the timer ends.
bullets: Check whether the sheet is Version A or Version B.
Keep the teacher in view before exposing the Phone.
Use Credits to improve the part of the run that slows you down.
Treat friends as partners only when you trust them not to snitch.

sections.heading: What Is Cheating During Testing?
sections.intro: It is a Roblox classroom game built around timed exams, risky gadget use and progression through Credits and better equipment.
paragraphs: The teacher can catch you cheating, so every glance at a gadget competes with the need to keep answering. A strong run is not just about knowing choices; it is about processing the sheet quickly enough to finish while the room stays manageable.

The social layer matters too. Snitches can expose players for Credits, while friends can cooperate and share information when their sheet versions match. Anxiety adds another reason to return attention to the desk instead of keeping the camera and Phone active for too long.
This Cheating During Testing Wiki is independent and fan-made. The in-game mechanics are fictional and are not advice for real tests.

sections.heading: Cheating During Testing Answers
sections.intro: There is not one permanent answer string for every test. Current BETA gameplay uses Version A and Version B sheets, then processes the player's own paper with the Phone.
paragraphs: A common method is to mark every answer A first. When the Phone scans the sheet, answers that are already correct can be skipped, leaving a shorter list of question-number corrections. Keep skipped questions at A and change only the numbered choices the Phone returns.

Check the version letter before copying a friend or video. Version A and Version B can use different answers, and a correction only belongs to the question number shown on the Phone. Review for blanks, double marks and numbering shifts before submitting.

sections.heading: How to Get 100% in Cheating During Testing
sections.intro: A 100% route combines the correct sheet version, the All-A baseline, Phone corrections, short teacher-safe windows and a final review before time expires.
paragraphs: Prepare the sheet before pulling out the Phone. Mark the baseline carefully, scan during a clear opening, put the device away early and transfer each returned question-number pair to the matching row. If the Phone processes answers in batches, repeat the scan-and-correct loop until the paper is complete.

Players commonly connect a perfect result with the Ultimate Cheater goal. The safest route is consistency: finish normal runs first, shorten Phone exposure, then push for 100% without losing the submission window to one last correction.

sections.heading: Cheating During Testing Phone Trick
sections.intro: The current Phone Trick uses an All-A starting sheet so the Phone can focus on the answers that need changing.
paragraphs: Open your sheet, check Version A or B and mark A across the paper. Wait until the teacher turns away, photograph your own sheet with the Phone, then read the question numbers and choices it returns. Put the Phone away before attention swings back and apply the corrections with the pencil.

Keep question numbers aligned and do not overwrite an A simply because the Phone skipped it. If the device returns only a small batch, use another safe window instead of assuming the first scan covered the whole test.

sections.heading: How to Get Credits in Cheating During Testing
sections.intro: Complete tests to earn Credits. Higher grades give larger rewards, so a reliable high-grade run is the main progression engine.
paragraphs: Improve the grade without sacrificing completion: use the correct sheet version, shorten Phone exposure and reserve time for a final review. Repeated finished tests also give clearer feedback than an ambitious run that ends before submission.

Spend Credits on the part of the loadout that addresses your current problem. Phone upgrades can support faster answer processing, while wearables such as the Smart Watch and Smart Glasses offer different utility for timing or information.

sections.heading: Cheating During Testing Items and Gadgets
sections.intro: Current BETA loadouts commonly discuss the Phone, Smart Watch and Smart Glasses alongside the normal answer-sheet and pencil tools.
paragraphs: The Phone is the core answer-processing gadget: it photographs your sheet and returns corrections. The Smart Watch is used as timing support, while Smart Glasses are discussed as an alternate information route involving other players or answers.

Choose by the problem you need to solve. Faster Phone processing helps reduce exposed time, timing support helps players who lose track of the clock, and information tools may suit coordinated play. sections.heading: How to Avoid Getting Caught
sections.intro: Watch the teacher before every gadget action, use short windows and put the Phone away earlier than you think you need to.
paragraphs: Prepare the sheet while facing the desk so the risky part of the loop is as short as possible. When the teacher turns away, scan or read a small batch, hide the Phone and return to the pencil. Do not stay exposed just to finish one more correction.
Anxiety, nearby players and Snitches can change a clean opportunity. If the room becomes uncertain, preserve the run and continue in another opening instead of forcing a 100% attempt.
